definitionZh: 边距-块启动 CSS 属性定义了元素的逻辑块起始边距,该边距根据元素的写法模式,方向性,和文本方向来映射到物理边距.
sourceDefinition: The margin-block-start CSS property defines the logical block start margin of an element, which maps to a physical margin depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
